findings: ReconcileExpired had only one production caller: daemon startup via cmd/openagentx/main.go.
RegisterWorker expires/fences an old Worker but does not settle old Task/Run.
TryClaimMailbox blocks work whenever any active-status Run exists, even when that Run lease expired.
BeginClaimedRunAttempt clamps initial Run lease to Worker lease; HeartbeatWorker extends active Run lease. Default 30s Worker lease is the relevant expiry bound, not 5m requested RunLease.

The existing recovery transaction selects only expired records, records actual state transitions in the same transaction, preserves accepted work, and uses uncertain rather than success/canceled. Repetition and rollback tests already exist.
Periodic loop performs no process cleanup. Bare CLI Worker SIGKILL may orphan descendants; supported user-systemd control-group cleanup must be verified separately.
systemd_evidence_boundary: Read-only loaded template properties, not a crash cleanup test. I acceptance must confirm actual created Agent unit and descendant termination.
minimal_fix: 10-second serial daemon recovery loop, startup fail-closed retained, context cancellation and join before repository close, errors logged and retried at next interval. No new state machine, no RegisterWorker mutation, no AGY/Worker behavior changes.
